# Purpose
This R Markdown document outlines the data cleaning, preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis (EDA) workflow applied to raw real estate datasets within the BDA400 analytics pipeline.

## Inputs
- **Raw Dataset**: `data/raw_housing_data.csv` containing raw property sales figures, square footage, bedroom counts, and sale prices.

## Outputs
- **Cleaned Dataset**: Processed dataframe with imputed missing values and standardized feature scales.
- **Visualizations**: Saved plots including `outputs/price_distribution_plot.png`.

library(dplyr)
